text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, um... Rob Roy-san...! About the 
birthday present you just gave me—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the 'Blue Rose of Happiness'... Big 
Brother's flowerpot...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the 'Blue Rose of Happiness'... Big 
Sister's flowerpot...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. It just happened to be on sale as a 
collaboration item, so...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Things like this make it feel like... I 
can reach out and touch the storybook 
world directly, so I think it's really 
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... I was hoping Rice-san might feel the 
same way...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'm so, so happy... Thank you, Rob 
Roy-san...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, you know... You know how some girls 
grow their own flowers next to the 
academy's flower beds?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice wants to grow blue roses in this 
flowerpot too...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, I think that's truly wonderful...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I gave it my all, pouring in lots 
of love... and then, and then――

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Just like the big brother in the picture 
book... I'll make wonderful roses 
bloom...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Just like the big sister in the picture 
book... I'll make wonderful roses 
bloom...!
